info.title: Tax Return Import/Export API
info.description:
This endpoint assigns groups, preparers, reviewers, managers, partners, and time tracking information to tax returns.

When using the /locator/v2/assignment endpoint to assign an existing locator to a group without updating time tracking dates, the timeTracking object must still be included in the request as an empty object ("timeTracking": {}); omitting it or passing null values will result in a 400 Bad Request.

The flag field accepts the following values:

Users:
- N: does nothing
- U: removes the assigned user
- C: assigns the user

Groups:
- N: does nothing
- U: removes the assigned groups
- C: assigns the groups

## Status codes for TRT Import/Export API:

### Import status:

| Status Code | Meaning |
|-------------|----------|
| 1 | Queued for Import |
| 2 | Generating Import file |
| 3 | File Import complete |
| 4 | File in use |
| 5 | Failed to create locator |
| 6 | Unable to Import |
| 7 | Import in progress |
| 8 | Import check-in in progress |
| 9 | Import aborted due to insufficient rights |
| 11 | Import aborted as No Locators available and no Charge record for locator |
| 20 | Invalid Import File |
| 22 | Validation error on import file |
| 23 | Validation warning on import file |
| 25 | Successful import with Validation Error |

### Export status:

| Status Code | Meaning |
|-------------|----------|
| 1 | Queued for export |
| 2 | File export complete |
| 3 | Locator in use |
| 4 | Return CheckedOut For Export |
| 5 | Unable to export |
| 6 | Export in progress |
| 7 | Staging export file |
| 8 | Unable to export |

post.summary: Triggers import or export for a tax return

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description:
This key is used to specify the import/Export type:Following are valid export event types

IEXEXPORT - Used for 1040, 1041, 1120, 1065, 990. Data connection XML
DCEXPORT - Used for 1040, 1041, 1120, 1065, 990 - Data connection
NPBEXPORT - Used only for 1040 - Partner of firm
DK1EXPORT - Used only for 1065 - Direct K-1
BNAEXPORT - Used for 1040 and 1120 - Bloomberg Tax Planner
CSIEXPORT - Used only for 1040 - Planner CS
CPREXPORT - Used for 1120 and 1065 - Columnar K-1
CCEXPORT - Used for 1041, 1120, 1065, 990 - Competitive Conversions
TRTCSVEXPORT - Used for 1120,1065,1040,1041,990,706,709,5500-Tax Return Transfer CSV format (Exported data is in CSV format)
TRTJSONEXPORT - USED for 1120,1065,1040,1041,990,706,709,5500-Tax return Transfer JSON format (Exported Data is in JSON format)

Following are valid import event types

IEXIMPORT - Used for 1040, 1041, 1120, 1065, 990 - Data connection XML
DCIMPORT - Used for 1040, 1041, 1120, 1065, 990 - Data connection
NPBIMPORT - Used only for 1040 - Partner of firm
DK1IMPORT - Used only for 1065 - Direct K-1
DK1CSVIMPORTFORMS - Used only for 1065 - Direct K-1 CSV format
CCIMPORT - Used for 1041, 1120, 1065, 990 - Competitive Conversions
TRTCSVIMPORT - Used for 1120,1065,1040,1041,990,706,709,5500 - Tax Return Transfer CSV format
TRTJSONIMPORT - USED for 1120,1065,1040,1041,990,706,709,5500 - Tax return Transfer JSON format
